propositions: The packaged top-level CLI help (overview.txt) and ticket-model.md documentation still claim unlink takes no relation argument, contradicting the shipped optional relation-scoped unlink feature.
The event-schema.md operation description does not distinguish between the optional relation selector in the unlink command and the emitted link-UUID cancellation in the UNLINK event.
Documentation sources must specify that an explicit canonical relation removes exactly that relation while preserving other active relations, and that omitting the relation falls back to most-recent.

Commit 73abb5805f added optional relation-scoped unlink to the library and CLI but updated only subcommand help and generated/user guide docs, omitting the independently maintained overview and ticket-model prose.
